turns.question: How much less budget did the search campaign have left at the end of September 2026 than at the end of August 2026, using each month's last snapshot?
turns.answer: Remaining budget (EUR) for the search channel at month end was EUR 4,305.00 for August 2026 (2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31) and EUR 2,130.00 for September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30), each from the campaigns' last snapshot in the month; the semantic layer returns the two levels, not their difference, so I give both rather than compute one myself. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
